# migration-checksums.txt — the checksum of every migration in the server's
# merged chain (src-app/server/migrations-merged, composed by build.rs), as sqlx
# stores it in each database: SHA-384 of the file's bytes, comments included.
#
# Applied migrations are immutable: a database that already ran a migration
# refuses to start when the file's bytes change. The test
# `database::tests::applied_migrations_keep_their_checksums` compares the
# embedded chain with this file, so such an edit fails the tests instead of
# every existing database.
#
# Adding a migration: append its line (the test prints it). Never change or
# remove an existing line; change the schema with a NEW migration instead.
#
# <version> <sha384 hex>  <file>
